data.gender_notes: Danishtha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Danishtha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Danishtha’ meaning ‘truth’. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Satya, who is the embodiment of truth. The name Danishtha is believed to bring clarity and honesty in one’s thoughts and actions. The name Danishtha carries the meaning “Goddess of truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Danishtha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Danishtha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Danishtha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
